name: week
title: Weekly credit-control desk
subtitle: Internal review only. Balances are imported snapshots, promises are not receipts.

sections.title: Ageing by entity and currency
sections.sql: select * from ageing_summary order by entity,currency

sections.title: Invoices and next action
sections.sql: select customer,number,currency,outstanding_cents,days_overdue,next_action from invoice_work order by days_overdue desc,number

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select number,customer,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by rule,number

sections.title: Unresolved promises
sections.sql: select customer,number,currency,amount_cents,due_on,status from promise_work where status='open' order by due_on
